# RentKonnect

> RentKonnect is rent tracking for Kenyan landlords. It bills every tenant automatically on the 1st, records M-Pesa payments the landlord pastes in, applies money to the oldest arrears first, and exports the twelve-month income history a bank asks for. Free while it is getting started.

RentKonnect is a web app, installable on Android and iOS, for landlords managing their own units in Kenya. It is made by Eddie Ezekiel Ochieng.

## What it does

- Bills rent automatically every month; arrears carry forward.
- Records payments from pasted M-Pesa confirmation messages, matched to tenants by phone number; the same code cannot be recorded twice.
- Applies part payments to the oldest unpaid month first.
- Shows each tenant's full statement: billed, paid and balance by month.
- Writes WhatsApp rent reminders, sent from the landlord's own number.
- Exports twelve months of collections, costs and average monthly net income as Excel or PDF.

## What it does not do

- It does not connect to M-Pesa or any bank, or collect rent on the landlord's behalf.
- Tenants do not get a login.
- It is not accounting or tax software.

## Pricing

Free while getting started. Planned plans: Basic, KSh 400 a month (up to 10 units); Business, KSh 900 a month (units without limit, expenses, bank exports and full history). Landlords already using it keep the price they joined on.
